messages:
maria: quick design pass on playground streaming — attached mocks. main pain: stop vs pause unclear, token counter too loud, prompt library peek pushes stream offscreen. figma: https://figma.com/file/playground-stream
sam: which two fixes first for beta?
maria: 1) clarify stop/pause copy + behavior. 2) reduce token counter visual weight during streaming.
alex: dev note: stop currently hard-cancels. pause holds/resumes. i can separate actions but need exact copy and small state machine.
aria: accessibility: stream should be aria-live=\"polite\". token counter must NOT be an additional live region. stop needs an accessible name explaining it discards partial output.
maria: copy idea: label \"Stop\" (tooltip: \"Stops and discards current generation\"), secondary \"Pause\" (tooltip: \"Pause streaming, resume later\"). short labels + tooltips.
sam: +1. ship short labels, test explicit ones in A/B.
alex: if stop destroys content, avoid modals on mobile. suggest toast: \"Generation stopped. Undo\" (5s). log undo events.
aria: toast must receive focus when announced and include keyboard-accessible undo button.
maria: token counter: propose default inline low-density under prompt; optional floating pill for power users in settings.
sam: default low-density, toggle for pill. track toggle usage.
alex: debounce token updates to 1s to avoid jank. easy to add server-side setting for persistence.
aria: contrast: floating pill needs AA at 14px; current mock fails. bump size or darken text/backdrop.
maria: prompt library peek: current drawer scrolls convo away. propose split panel on desktop, overlay on narrow screens so stream remains visible.
alex: i'll implement split >=1024px, overlay otherwise.
sam: propose A/B overlay vs split for 2 weeks. metrics: regenerate rate, stop vs pause ratio, prompt open during stream, token toggle adoption.
maria: assign follow-ups: alex implements toggles+undo toast+debounce; aria owns accessibility test plan; sam sets up metrics and dashboard.
ci-bot: branch created: playground/stream-ux-experiment. CI green.
sam: i'll add analytics events this week.
alex: PR coming with screenshots for responsive states.
aria: i'll run axe + NVDA tests once branch is up.
maria: thanks — small scope, big clarity wins. :sparkles:
